info.description: Private read-only Momentum catalogue. UTC dates/timestamps; finite JSON. Clients should send Accept: application/json, application/problem+json to receive both successful representations and problem details. For application/json, Accept charset parameters have no effect; quality weights still apply and output remains UTF-8. Lists are ordered by created_at DESC, id DESC, with filter-bound keyset tokens and no snapshot guarantee under concurrent updates. Latest selects one winner per ticker before rating filters. Unknown ticker returns an empty page. Every GET/HEAD resource rejects bodies and duplicate or unknown query parameters. Only list endpoints accept query parameters; OPTIONS does not validate them. Error types: https://github.com/kaligautier/trading-on-IBKR-with-ADK-/blob/main/apps/backend/momentum-api/README.md#forbidden, current-analysis, suggestion-quota, payload-too-large, unsupported-media-type, invalid-argument, invalid-request, invalid-token, analysis-not-found, not-found, method-not-allowed, not-acceptable, precondition-failed, invalid-stored-data, configuration-error, store-unavailable, internal-error, not-implemented
